The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#736; borg-reborn-rs #885, #917, PR #1128 at 7bfbe121: track-p d3d1629f merged with #1128 and its review fixes; the belief switches of #889 are P9 and not asked for). Four arms (both switches compiled and shipped 0, so ctl is track-p d3d1629f's play): ctl; dark (update_dark_clears_light 1: a floor grid the engine shows neither glowing nor lit loses BORG_LIGHT); rubble (view_rubble_blocks_sight 1: passable rubble stops the Borg's view); both. Pilot (classes-18) as the gate; if the pilot plays differently, the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm, matching #702); if capacity is short a rubble / ctl pilot alone is the most informative. Smoke at the specimen: dark 4/4 identical, rubble 2/4. Wanted: the signature, the count of '# Forgetting a monster' notes per arm and deaths within 200 game turns of a forget of the killer's race; for rubble, deaths and forgets with passable rubble within two grids of the forgotten monster's last grid if the evidence allows. The result decides whether each switch ships in P8.
Tier pilot: classes-18, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, 100,000 turns. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm. Report per arm and class: deaths and causes, rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), CL and depth, alive at the cap having reached DL5, identical plays; progress (DL3/DL5 reached, first_turn_at_depth, #718 fields). Descriptive (RULES 14).
